articles.title: Spain’s spy agency warned of plans to storm Ceuta before mass migrant crossing, documents show - CNN
articles.description: Spanish intelligence services warned their Moroccan counterparts and Madrid of plans to storm Ceuta a day before more than 70,000 migrants crossed into Spain’s North African enclave, according to documents released by the government on Wednesday.
